comment: Tank asset manifest. Rig conventions proven by headless GLB forensics:
the gun-barrel bounding-box asymmetry (+4.73 m vs -3.56 m) puts the nose
on glTF +Z, so hosts apply yawTrimDeg 180 to make heading 0 face north;
the ground plane sits at y = -1.098 m, so hosts lift the wrapper by
groundLiftM to put the tracks on the surface.
